title: Iran asserts/presses control over Strait of Hormuz
rationale: Headlines: 'Strait of Hormuz remains closed', Iran navy 'full control', and mine warfare hampers US control.

title: Further tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz
rationale: Two tankers hit in Strait; multiple reports of tankers struck and rising oil price after attacks.

title: US announces new Iran-related bank sanctions
rationale: Bessent says US likely to announce Iran bank sanctions this week; Treasury moves against Egyptian bank, UAE branch cited.

title: Expanded secondary sanctions against third‑party banks
rationale: Treasury imposes limits on Egyptian bank, targets UAE/Egypt branches; reporting of weekly new US secondary sanctions.

title: Continued US strikes on Iranian targets
rationale: Multiple headlines: US strikes Larak, Kharg; Trump vows to 'hit them hard' and US launches further strikes.

title: US blockade further restricts Iranian oil exports
rationale: Headlines: 'U.S. Navy blockade slashes Iran oil exports' and 'Blockade succeeds where sanctions failed'.

title: Intermittent diplomacy and pressure around interim deal
rationale: Headlines: 'Iran urges US to comply with interim deal' and 'Iran talks sputter' indicate fragile diplomacy.

title: China deepens regional diplomatic and economic ties

title: U.S. munitions depletion and replenishment pressure
rationale: Headlines: 'Drain on U.S. Munitions' and 'America’s Systemic Munitions Shortfall' raise replenishment concerns.
